data.one_liner: Firebase Admin SDK implementation for Dart server environments
data.what_it_does: Enables Dart servers and privileged environments to access Firebase services including Firestore, Cloud Storage, Auth, and Cloud Messaging. It provides authentication and database access using service accounts or application default credentials.
use_when: You are building a backend server or cloud function in Dart that needs to interact with Firebase
You need administrative access to Firebase Authentication, Firestore, or Cloud Storage from a server
avoid_when: You are building a client-side Flutter application (use official client packages instead)
You require Realtime Database support, which is not currently supported by this package
strengths: Allows full Dart stack development including server-side Firebase integration
Supports multiple authentication methods including service accounts and Workload Identity Federation
weaknesses: Some Firebase services like Realtime Database and Data Connect are not supported
Requires server-side setup and secure management of service account credentials
data.setup_notes: Requires a Firebase project, downloading a service account JSON file or configuring environment variables like GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.
